paper.title: On Lai's Upper Confidence Bound in Multi-Armed Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed bandit with Gaussian rewards, fixed horizon T
unmapped: Arm variances are unknown but bounded above by a known sigma^2 used by the algorithm
Regret counted only after the K initialization rounds (horizon T' = T-K)
settings.definition_quote: We focus on a $K$-armed bandit problem with a fixed time horizon $T$, $2 \le K \le T$, and assume that the rewards sampled from arm $a$ are independent and identically distributed Gaussian random variables with mean $\mu_a$ and a variance no greater than $\sigma^2$.

algorithms.name: UCB with constant level of exploration b_{T'}
Lai's UCB with g(x)=1 v log x (kl-UCB+ for fixed horizon, Gaussian)

symbols.b_T: exploration level b_{T'} of the UCB index

source.label: th-Gaussian-LaiRobbins-T
source.quote: Suppose the rewards from arm $a$ follow a Gaussian distribution with mean $\mu_a$ and no greater variance than $\sigma^2$ for all $a=1,\ldots,K$. Then, the regret of the UCB rule \eqref{UCB-rule-T} is bounded by R_{T'} \le \sum_{a:\mu_a<\mu^*}\frac{\sigma^2(b_{T'}^2+1+\eta(b_{T'}))}{\mu^* - \mu_a}

results.notes: Regret R_{T'} counts rounds K+1..T only and equals sum Delta_a E[n_{a,T}-1], i.e. pseudo-regret.

source.label: cor-Gaussian-LaiRobbins-T-1
source.quote: Setting $b_{T'}=\sqrt{2\log T'}$ in \eqref{UCB-rule-T}, we find that R_{T'} \le \sum_{a:\mu_a<\mu^*}\frac{\sigma^2(2\log T'+c_1(T'))}{\mu^* - \mu_a}, where $c_1(T') =o(1)$ as $T' \rightarrow \infty$ and $c_1(T') \le 10.1, 7, 5.5, 4, 3\ldots$ for $T' \ge 2, 20, 40, 100, 200\ldots$.

results.notes: Constants obtained via numerical evaluation. Remark 4 notes the uniform asymptotic optimality limsup sup_mu R/(log T' sum 2sigma^2/Delta) <= 1.

symbols.eps_T: eps_{T'} = o(1) as T' -> infinity, depending on T' only

source.label: cor-Gaussian-LaiRobbins-T-2
source.quote: The UCB rule \eqref{UCB-rule-T} with the exploration level $b_{T'}$ in \eqref{th-Gaussian-LaiRobbins-T-4} enjoys the following regret bound, R_{T'} \le \sum_{a:\mu_a<\mu^*}\frac{\sigma^2(2\log T' - 3\log\log(T') -\log \pi +1 +\eps_{T'})}{\mu^* - \mu_a} for some $\eps_{T'} = o(1)$ depending on $T'$ only.

results.notes: Lower-order terms negative for large T'.

symbols.L_i: L(T' gamma_i^2) with L(x) = log_+(x/log_+(x/log_+(x))), log_+(x)=max(1, log x), gamma_i = Delta_i/sigma, T'=T-K
symbols.eps_i: eps_{a,T'} <= 14.8, eps_{a,T'} -> 0 as T' gamma_a^2 -> infinity

tuning: exploration function g(x) = 1 v log x

source.label: th-Gaussian-Lai-T
source.quote: Suppose the rewards from arm $a$ follow a Gaussian distribution with mean $\mu_a$ and no greater variance than $\sigma^2$ for all $a=1,\ldots,K$. Let $\gamma_a = (\mu^* - \mu_a)/\sigma$. Then, the UCB index policy in \eqref{UCB-rule-Lai} satisfies R_{T'} \le \sum_{a:\mu_a< \mu^*} \frac{\sigma^2\big(2L(T'\gamma_a^2)+1+\eps_{a,T'}\big)}{\mu^* - \mu_a} where ... $L(x) = \log_+(x/\log_+(x/\log_+(x)))$, and $\eps_{a,T'}$ is uniformly bounded with $\eps_{a,T'}\le 14.8$ and $\eps_{a,T'}\to 0$ as $T'\gamma_a^2\to\infty$.

results.notes: Pseudo-regret after the K initialization rounds.
